svg.aria-label: The path of a document. Boxes: Find each document: a document.yaml folder or a .yaml file (part of Officium); Parse the YAML, src/lib/data/parse.ts (part of Officium); Validate the fields, src/lib/data/validate.ts (part of Officium); Check the images, and in the browser and oculus builds the PDF, lie in the library (part of Officium); Check unique id and order, then sort, src/lib/data/order.ts (part of Officium); The reader shows the documents (part of Officium); Library screen: the load error (what the user sees on a refusal).
